correctness.rationale: For q>=2 unique strict length-four maximum under two-state row-stochastic probabilistic automata exists for each of 13 nonconstant nonexceptional restricted-growth patterns. Independently evaluated all exact rational two-state certificates in CERTIFICATES.json using BigInt denominator-cleared recurrence and all s^4 active-letter competitors for each s<=4; all 13 claimed exact gaps matched, including 0123 margin 35/4096. Constant word has a trivial two-state accepting witness, and one state cannot distinguish words. Gill's binary lower bound for 0100=abaa survives restriction to the two used letters; Kjos-Hanssen's general three-state bound supplies the upper bound. For unused letters take an average of active matrices: any word containing one expands as a strictly suboptimal convex combination, since every active replacement differs from the original target at that position. Exactly q(q-1) exceptional words follow.
